label: Formal Card Holder
description: The formal card holder is a discreet slip of fabric attached on the surface of the jacket above the right hip pocket, engineered to hold cards or a folded ticket without creating any pocket mouth in the outer cloth. It effectively eliminates the visual interruption of a traditional ticket pocket while preserving the function, and is the preferred solution on the most formal bespoke commissions — morning coats, court dress, and ceremonial frock coats — where even a small jetted opening would disturb an otherwise immaculate front.
